title: 第18章 物质食粮精神食粮一次性满足第19章 穿越者最轻易能获得的武器黑火药炸药包
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
此次分田地由于阿宁贝斯的特殊人口组成机制，根本无法按户发放土地。
因此，林恩选择了初步分发土地法案，每一个人都将获得一块地，地不会太大，也不会太小，刚好为一个劳动力能耕种的极限。
每一个人三亩田大概就能把一位成年男性累的半死了。
城外刚刚砍伐完森林的平原上，林恩带着人真正把田地分成一块一块的，等分三亩地，同时插上木牌，写上是谁的地。
“真的假的啊，领主大人居然分地。”
“太奇怪了吧。”
众人议论纷纷，成为奴隶后，遇到个领主，给你废奴隶身份，给你发田地，什么魔幻剧情？
这种离谱到极点的事情真就发生在了每一个人身上。
林恩领着人测量着土地，然后敲下木牌，在上面写上文字，同时使用廉价的史莱姆液体作为颜色标记，隔开每一寸土地。
做完这些后，林恩又把准备好的纸写上文字，盖好印章。
“来，这是你的了。”林恩拿起一张纸，使用史莱姆包裹好，同时使用魔法【黄毛系统出品，史莱姆硅胶化。】想想黄毛系统恶堕女主们需要什么东西？
这些东西林恩开发出了另一种使用途径，史莱姆的特殊成分极其离谱。
首先，它就像橡胶一样，经过魔法处理可以做成小玩具。
同时史莱姆其实是魔物的一种，拥有生命，液体带毒，可以提取出毒药。
真要形容的话，史莱姆就是一种拥有生命的橡胶生物，他身体吸水还带有黏性，这个世界，胶水大多数都是来源于史莱姆。
至于硅胶玩具，大家没开发出来，因为史莱姆液体是带毒的，大家都不敢。
林恩则因为黄毛系统教的史莱姆一万种使用方法，学会了这个。
领地教认识字还没有普及开来，莉莉姆还在努力在教，所以大多数人都是不认识字的。
但他们却将这个视为珍宝，领主大人说，这是他的土地了。
哪位身材瘦弱的老大叔颤抖的接过那张纸。

我有土地了？
我有地了？
我有地了！
所有人都异常兴奋。
有的人接过那张纸后甚至去亲吻土地。
幸福是对比出来。
如果说这个世界存在大量的农奴，奴隶，这个世界有人跑过来给你土地，那自然会感恩戴德。
人需要精神食粮和物质食粮，现在林恩全部都给出来了。
精神食粮是阿宁斯贝主义。
物质食粮就是现在的这些土地，还有将要建造的免费房子。
“来，你的地。”林恩拿出两份纸递给了莉莉姆和达尼娅。
“我也有？”莉莉姆懵逼道。
“主人我怎么也有？”达尼娅更加懵逼了：“我有土地也不会耕种啊。”
林恩伸了一下懒腰：“我这叫做一视同仁，以后阿宁斯贝发展起来后，你这些土地也许价值一万金币哦~”
这种一视同仁的分发田地，除了林恩自己，其他人全部都收到了。
林恩表示，天下不归我所有，但都归我所用，才是最高级的控制。
随着分发土地下去，林恩的阿宁斯贝也是发生了一些变化。
......
矮人们聚在一起，史密斯拿着那张纸和他的兄弟们互相你看我，我看你。
史密斯不禁感叹道：“我是遇到了什么圣人吗？”
content_en:
Due to the special population composition mechanism of Animbes, it is impossible to allocate land to households this time.
Therefore, Lynn chose a preliminary land distribution bill. Everyone would get a piece of land, not too big, not too small, just the limit of what one labor force could cultivate.
Three acres of land per person can probably tire an adult male to half death.
On the plain where the forest had just been cut down outside the city, Lin En led people to actually divide the fields into three acres of land, and at the same time put wooden signs to write whose land it was.
"It's true, the lord actually divided the land."
"It's so weird."
Everyone is talking about it. After you become a slave, you meet a lord who cancels your status as a slave and gives you fields. What kind of magical plot?
This outrageous thing really happens to everyone.
Linn led the people to measure the land, then knocked down the wooden signs and wrote words on them. At the same time, he used cheap slime liquid as color markers to separate every inch of the land.
After doing this, Linn wrote on the prepared paper and stamped it.
"Here, this is yours." Linn picked up a piece of paper, wrapped it in slime, and at the same time used magic [produced by Huangmao System, silicone slime. 】Think about what the evil heroines of the Yellow Hair System need?
Lynn has developed another way to use these things, and the special ingredients of slime are extremely outrageous.
First, it's like rubber that can be magically processed into small toys.
At the same time, slime is actually a kind of monster. It has life and the liquid is poisonous, and poison can be extracted.
If you really want to describe it, slime is a living rubber creature. Its body absorbs water and is sticky. Most of the glue in this world comes from slime.
As for silicone toys, no one has developed them because slime liquid is poisonous and no one dares to do so.
Lin En learned this because of the 10,000 ways to use slime taught by Huangmao System.
The literacy teaching in the territory has not yet become popular, and Lilim is still working hard to teach it, so most people do not know the literacy.
But they regarded this as a treasure, and the lord said that this was his land.
The thin old man took the piece of paper tremblingly.
Do I have land?
Do I have land?
I have land!
Everyone was extremely excited.
Some people even kissed the ground after taking the piece of paper.
Happiness comes from contrast.
If there are a large number of serfs and slaves in this world, and if someone comes to give you land, then you will naturally be grateful.
People need spiritual food and material food, and now Lin En has provided them all.
The spiritual food is Aninsbyism.
The material food is the land now and the free houses that will be built.
"Here, your land." Linn took out two pieces of paper and handed them to Lilim and Dania.
"Me too?" Lilim asked confused.
"How come I don't have a master?" Dania was even more confused: "I have land but I don't know how to cultivate it."
Lin En stretched his body and said, "I call it treating everyone equally. When Aningsibe develops in the future, your land may be worth 10,000 gold coins~"
This kind of distribution field was distributed equally, and everyone except Linn himself received it.
Lin En said that the world does not belong to me, but it all belongs to me, which is the highest level of control.
As the land distribution continued, Linn's Aningsi Bay also underwent some changes.
...
The dwarves gathered together, and Smith took the piece of paper and looked at each other with his brothers.
Smith couldn't help but sigh: "Did I meet some saint?"
